description: Picks a random note each time it is triggered and holds that note at its output as a 1V/oct pitch

params.text: Picks a new note on each press
Sets how often the lowest note of the polyphonic input is picked instead of a random one, none at -4V rising to every time at 4V, and it changes nothing while Poly In is unpatched
Sets the span the random note is picked from, one octave at -4V rising to nine octaves at 4V

inputs.text: A polyphonic 1V/oct signal giving the notes the random pick is drawn from; with nothing patched the pick is any semitone from C3 upwards within the span set by Range
A rising edge picks a new note; it reads high at 1V and low at 0.1V
Sets the root bias in place of the Root Bias knob while a cable is patched, none at -4V rising to every time at 4V
Sets the span in place of the Range knob while a cable is patched, one octave at -4V rising to nine octaves at 4V

outputs.text: The note last picked, held as a 1V/oct pitch until the next trigger

notes: the display names the note last picked, and it takes no click
the module picks nothing on its own. Until the button is pressed or a trigger arrives the output holds 0V, the C the module starts on, and the display reads C
